changes.comment: sdk-ui: Stop reporting the cancellation of a superseded execution as an execution failure. withEntireDataView decided whether a response was still relevant by comparing execution definition fingerprints, which does not identify a request: when the same definition is requested again after a different one, an already-cancelled earlier request stops looking superseded and its AbortError is delivered through onError. Analytical Designer showed "Sorry, we can't display this visualization" over a chart that had loaded, whenever a saved insight carrying a sort was opened. The staleness check now keys on the request itself.
